title: Hair Ends Trimmer Split Remover Dry Damaged Brittle Professional Automatic Trim Split For Women Cordless Hair Cutting Machine
body_html:
Material: ABS

Color: Pink

Gross Weight per Unit: 400g

Net Weight per Unit: 266g

Product Dimensions: 25.5 * 5.2 * 4.8cm

Box Dimensions: 28.8 * 8.8 * 5.8cm

Voltage: 3.7V

Battery Capacity: 500mAh

Charging Interface: Type-C

Package Contents:
Trim Tool *1
Brush *1
Hair Clips *2
Charger *1

Preparation Before Use:

1. After shampooing, thoroughly dry your hair and comb it smoothly, avoiding pulling.

2. Note: Hair must be clean. Dirty hair is prone to tangling, resulting in uneven trimming. This product only trims the ends, not the length.

Instructions for Use:

1. Charge before use. A red indicator light will illuminate while charging; a green indicator light will illuminate when fully charged.

2. Press the power button on the back of the device upwards to turn it on. At this point, both the blue hair care indicator light and the lithium battery power indicator light will illuminate (green indicates sufficient power, red indicates flashing). The machine needs to be charged.

3. After straightening the hair, take a small amount of hair and place it into the machine, then close it. The machine will begin conditioning and trimming, moving slowly downwards to straighten the hair.

4. Repeat step 3 until all the hair has been trimmed. If there is too much hair inside the machine, you can open the transparent cover to pour out the trimmed hair.
